scope: Isolated Qwen3-0.6B Q4 evaluation harness only; no shipping changes
skill: diagnosing-bugs: reproduce, minimize, rank falsifiable hypotheses, measure phases, change one variable, rerun real-device regression, remove temporary instrumentation
status: Repeated-run regression fixed; manual Stop/background/recovery passed and corroborated by native reports
originalFailure: 3 GiB pre-load headroom threshold refused third run after two completed 2K answers

findings.finding: Foundation hash-read temporaries accumulated across the whole GGUF despite 1 MiB reads
findings.fix: Drain an autorelease pool around each read-and-hash chunk. Exact SHA-256 verification and cancellation remain.
findings.limitation: This fix alone did not resolve the pre-load threshold refusal.

findings.finding: The inherited 3 GiB headroom rule refused loading despite remaining headroom exceeding this compact model's observed footprint
findings.diagnostic: With a bounded 2 GiB reserve, all 20 2K probes completed; post-cleanup footprint after warmup remained approximately 337–348 MB.
findings.interpretation: Bounded retained native/runtime memory over this test, not evidence of an unbounded leak. No exact allocation owner was established.
findings.policy: Use a 2 GiB pre-load reserve for this pinned 0.6B model only. Keep OS memory-warning cancellation; do not copy this policy to larger models.

originalSevenProbeReplay.outcomes: Six completed answers plus expected injected eight-token cancellation

twentyProbeReplay.outcomes: 20 completed answers in one process; no reset or settle delays

validation.caveats: Finite resource and manual-lifecycle evaluation, not production release approval. Near-full context, extended multi-turn/thermal/energy behavior and shipping integration remain unqualified.
